activities.name: Blue whales off Mirissa
activities.note: Sri Lanka runs two monsoons on opposite coasts, so its whale watching moves round the island rather than stopping

windows.reason: calm water off the south coast and blue whales reliably present
the edges of the southern season, which runs roughly November to April

activities.name: Whale watching off Trincomalee
activities.note: the east coast's season is the mirror image of the south's — when one shuts, the other opens

windows.reason: the east-coast season runs May to September, with blue whales off Trincomalee from about March to July
the later part of the eastern season

activities.name: Climbing Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
activities.note: outside the pilgrimage season the mountain is deserted, the trail's seasonal stalls are shut, and rain and wind make the steps hazardous

windows.reason: the pilgrimage season: the path is lit and busy with pilgrims, and the stalls along it are open
the season opens on the December full moon (Unduvap) and closes on the Vesak full moon in May

activities.name: Kandy Esala Perahera
activities.note: the nights of processions end on the Nikini full moon, so the dates move each year

windows.reason: about two weeks of night processions in Kandy, held in July and August

activities.name: The elephant gathering at Minneriya
activities.note: the gathering is driven by the dry season, when the man-made Minneriya tank is the area's reliable water

windows.reason: the peak, when the dry season draws herds of up to 300 elephants to graze the receding shore of the Minneriya tank
the gathering builds from July and lasts into October

activities.name: Surfing at Arugam Bay
activities.note: the east coast's surf comes with the southwest monsoon; outside it, schools teach beginners only when conditions allow

windows.reason: the main season, when the southwest monsoon brings the best waves to the east coast
the season's start, with less consistent waves but thinner crowds
